brief_summary: This clinical trial examines whether the addition of individual sessions of a motivational intervention to a state-of-the art behavioral group weight loss intervention for overweight women with Type 2 diabetes improves the weight losses and glycemic control outcomes.
brief_title: NEW DAY: Nutrition, Exercise, Weight Loss, Diabetes And You

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body Mass Index of 27 - 50
* Type 2 diabetes currently treated with oral medications
* Ability to walk for exercise

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of insulin
* Current pregnancy
* Presence of debilitating disease, psychotic condition or any other condition that might interfere with participation
* Failure to complete self monitoring diary for 1 week
* Plans to move out of the area in the upcoming 18 months

lead_sponsor.name: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)

official_title: Obesity Treatment and NIDDM in Black and White Women
